title: Metallographic Determination Of Apparent Porosity And Uncombined Carbon In Hard Metals - Method ( First Revision )
clause_1_scope: This standard specifies the procedure for the metallographic determination of the presence, type and distribution of porosity and uncombined carbon in hardmetals.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Metallographic Sample Preparation Of Hardmetals - Method ( First Revision )
Metallographic Determination Of Microstructure In Hard Metals - Method ( First Revision )

clause_3_terminology: Metallographic Determination Of Apparent Porosity And Uncombined Carbon In Hard Metals

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
